## Caveats
- Full-history is ~6 years; CAGR ~ (1+full_compounded/100)^(1/6)-1 (annualised).
- 5× DD = -100% means equity wiped at some point in compounding sequence.
- Real deployment requires concurrent-position cap and per-trade risk sizing.
- These are TRADE-LEVEL stats (sequential). Multiple triggers in same trend would compound — assumption is each trade is independent.
